name: Saeki Reika
source:
Daughter of a boss company.
Always trying to act firm due to her position as swimming club manager.
A hard working girl yet sometimes couldn't see what's around her.
Therefore some people see her as cold and coercive, her trust is also something hard to obtain.
Having a complex on her chest and height measurement.
